newsitem.title: USA: Chile seeks 960,000 bbls of crude for end-June.
newsitem.headline: Chile seeks 960,000 bbls of crude for end-June.

text.p: Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) is seeking to buy 960,000 barrels of crude oil for delivery around June 25-30, trade sources said on Tuesday.
The tender will be awarded on May 8.
In its last purchase tender, Chile purchased 900,000 barrels of Nigerian Forcados and 380,000 barrels of Ecuadoran Oriente for delivery at the end of May to early June.

Separately, Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol awarded a cargo each of Cano Limon and South Blend at discounts of $2.97 and $3.30 to benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing on an fob basis, trade sources said.
The Cano Limon cargo, which loads June 13-23, was awarded to a U.S. West Coast refiner.
The South Blend loads June 20-30. The buyer was not disclosed.
